chunks: The worst of foods is consuming the wealth of an orphan unjustly.

key_terms.شَرُّ الْمَآكِلِ: the worst kind of what is consumed
key_terms.مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ: the property or wealth belonging to an orphan

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about consuming the wealth of an orphan unjustly?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns the wrongful consumption of an orphan’s property in the strongest moral terms. It highlights the grave injustice of exploiting the weak and emphasizes the protection of the financial rights of orphans.
